text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I did it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I went and showed them real results!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
"Sis!!
Are you listenin' to me?!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone from Kokura
text_block_list.text: You really gave it your all out there!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah!
I hear ya, thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Everyone from Kokura
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, looking good!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That, you see,
everyone from Kokura's shopping district came to visit.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And you did all that for someone you barely talked to?
It's not like you've got time to waste...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...When people cheer for me like that, it makes me feel like this is where I'm meant to be.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just need to take it one step at a time, staying true to myself...
and keep moving forward, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even if I don't know whether it'll reach or not...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer.
I'm about to say something pretty uncool."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Can I beat Teio?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Juuust kidding!
I'm joking, so please forget it—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...!
Uh-oh... Aww.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, I knew you'd say that, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Asking when you already know the answer is downright cowardly, yes.
However...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I can't really move forward unless I get a good kick in the rear, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Knowing Teio as she charges down the Classic road,
her next move is surely—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —She should be aiming for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to... run in the Kikuka Sho next.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: How... is it...?
choice_data_list: The distance is going to be quite a bit longer, but that's no problem, right?
The distance is going to be quite a bit longer, but that's no problem, right?

text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is 3,000 meters.
That's a full 1,000 meters longer
than the Kokura Kinen she just ran.

It might be a difficult battle for Nice Nature.
However, if she's made up her mind...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there are plenty of problems.
Like, super loooong distances probably aren't my thing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But...
I'm not really in the mood to back down.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Let's run the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's decided.
I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"There's no running away now, Nature.
A head-to-head showdown in a major race..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But... yeah.
I guess... it's not so bad.

"...She seems to have regained some of her confidence,
but couldn't I give her a little more of a push
heading into the Kikuka Sho?"
When I thought about it that way, what came to mind was—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No matter what results I get, everyone is happy for me.
They smile and tell me I did my best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't really tell for myself.
Yeah... I can't bring myself to say I gave it my all, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like, first place is pretty straightforward, right?
You get a trophy, or the shield if it's the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that makes me feel like my hard work paid off.
...Though that feeling is a privilege reserved only for 1st place.

"...Maybe there's something
that I can do, too!"

—And so, the next day.
On the way back to the Ritto Center from Kokura...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Can I have the snacks I left with you~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You know, the Japanese sweets everyone in Kokura gave me. I was thinking of snacking on them on the Shinkansen.
(Rustle, rustle... flutter)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, something's about to fall.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Is this... an origami trophy?
It looks kinda flimsy, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oho, from the Trainer? Heheh,
aren't you into cute things~?
choice_data_list: I was thinking of giving it to Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh~...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? To me!?
Why...?
choice_data_list: I want to turn this into confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Into confidence...?

I understand how it feels to lack confidence,
no matter what results you achieve.

"Then if you have tangible proof of your achievements,
wouldn't that give you a bit more confidence?
I shared those thoughts with her..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Going out of your way, just for me...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...So a grown adult spent their time in a hotel room
fiddling around through trial and error to make a trophy?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm not an elementary schooler, you know.

...I see. Though I made it,
I worried it seemed condescending, like treating them like a child,
so I hesitated to hand it over...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if I must.
Very well, I shall graciously accept it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're surprised now?
You made this for me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hand it over quickly.
Otherwise I'm not going home.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...That's why.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Because a wobbly trophy is just perfect for me."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The fake-looking gold plating, the crumpled edges and all. It all... feels so much like me, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Kinda like... a feeling of kinship? Or something.
...Yeah, so, what I mean is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll be expecting the next guy
to be just a little bit better."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: After all, the races will keep on coming. You'll need to do your best too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll do my absolute best in the race, okay?
